content: विधृ €10 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To seize, catch, catch or take hold of; अंशुकपल्लवेन विधृतः <ls>Amaru. 85</ls>. .²2 To put on, wear, use; पर्णशालामथ क्षिप्रं विधृतासिः प्रविश्य सः <ls>R. 12. 40</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²3 To maintain, bear, support, hold up; शिरसा विधृता नित्यम् <ls>Pt. 1. 82</ls> (where sense 2 is also intended); विधृतमपरैर्दत्तं चान्यैर्विजित्य तृणं यथा <ls>Bh. 3. 23</ls>. .²4 To fix upon, direct towards. .²5 To separate, divide. .²6 To arrange, manage. .²7 To withhold, obstruct, restrain.
